english.title: Economic operator fail to identify supplier of civil explosive to market surveillance authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an economic operator who received a request from the market surveillance authority before the end of the relevant period, failed, within the period specified by the authority, namely **(..SPECIFY END OF RELEVANT PERIOD..), to identify to the authority an economic operator

(A)_[who supplied you with]_
(B)_[to whom you had supplied]_

a civil explosive to which this regulation 63 of the Explosives Regulations 2014 applied
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 63(2) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of, and paragraph 7(m) of Schedule 12 to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc. 1974.

english.notes:
(i) This regulation applies in relation to civil explosives excluded from the scope of regulations 33, 34 and 36 by virtue of regulation 3(15), see regulation 63(1).
(ii) For relevant period see regulation 63(3).
